body.label: Target
body.html: A line of 3 connected spaces within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Concentration: fill the line with a temporary shadow curtain that provides concealment, not solid cover, for up to 3 rounds.

surges.html: Yourself or one willing ally within 3 units gains +1 Composure against sensory effects until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Shadow Thread
rider.html: Gain a Shadow Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: after resolving, choose two adjacent spaces within 3 units; they provide concealment until the start of your next turn.
